fixed_features.feature: Single ln x differentiated with respect to x
fixed_features.justification: Canonical 6624681a-bb00-59db-8df9-4d5a3cd00434 and tutorial b1f46211-3766-53d0-bcc7-30bb9056b948 establish this exact operation; other logarithm tasks are separate KPs.
This is the constant multiple rule itself; fixing that relationship is essential, while fixing its value or excluding reciprocal coefficients is not.
